plaatsen.tekst: He moveth his tail like a cedar: the sinews of his stones are wrapped together.
And I will lay sinews upon you, and will bring up flesh upon you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and ye shall live; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
And when I beheld, lo, the sinews and the flesh came up upon them, and the skin covered them above: but there was no breath
Therefore the children of Israel eat not of the sinew which shrank, which is upon the hollow of the thigh, unto this day: because he touched the hollow of Jacob's thigh in the sinew that shrank.
